tagline: An integrated energy company leveraging innovation and sustainability to deliver transition leadership across exploration, production, renewables, and low-carbon technologies.
hero_kpi_rationale: Eni is investing heavily in energy transition and new technologies such as CCS and batteries, which is a key driver for its future growth and differentiation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Company spending to acquire or improve physical assets such as plants or equipment.
kpis.description: Net CAPEX is well below guidance, indicating financial discipline in strategic investments.
kpis.signal: Significant investments in energy transition and future growth.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, before other expenses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by the company's core operations relative to its revenue.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.

kpis.name: Gearing Ratio (Net Debt to Equity)
kpis.explanation: Measure of the company's net debt relative to its equity and net debt.
kpis.description: Adjusted net debt is declining, moving from 18% to 14% (pro forma), demonstrating prudent financial management.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by core operations, adjusted for certain non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted operational cash flow generation reached EUR 13.8 bn for the fiscal year, up 20% versus previous guidance, supporting financial strategy and distributions.
kpis.signal: Strong cash generation supporting shareholder distributions.

kpis.name: Total Shareholder Distribution
kpis.explanation: Total amount returned to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks.
kpis.description: Total distribution including increased share buyback of EUR 2.8 bn reflects material shareholder participation in performance and improved scenarios.
kpis.signal: Significant shareholder return aligned with distribution policy.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 137.07 bn in latest year

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Generation Capacity
kpis.explanation: Installed capacity for electricity generation from renewable sources.
kpis.description: Renewable energy generation capacity increased 41% year-over-year, illustrating execution of Eni's transition strategy.
kpis.signal: Rapid and strategic growth of renewable portfolio.

kpis.name: Biorefineries Construction
kpis.explanation: Progress in construction and approval of new facilities to produce sustainable fuels and chemicals.
kpis.description: Two major biorefining projects approved at Sannazzaro and Priolo hubs, marking acceleration of transition strategy with self-financing economic models.
kpis.signal: Major strategic expansion in sustainable chemicals and fuels.

kpis.name: Carbon Capture and Storage Transaction
kpis.explanation: Agreement and investment in CO2 capture and storage projects to reduce emissions.
kpis.description: The low-carbon technology portfolio including CCS strengthens Eni's position in energy transition and carbon neutrality by mid-century.
kpis.signal: Strategic commitment to low-carbon technologies and decarbonization.

kpis.name: Exploration & Production Output Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in hydrocarbon production from exploration and production activities.
kpis.description: E&P production reached 1.8 million bbl oil equivalent per day in Q1 2026, up 9% year-over-year, resulting from exceptional discoveries and rapid reserve development.
kpis.signal: Significant organic growth supported by discovery fundamentals.

risks.title: Dependence on Concession Contracts and PSAs
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk for E&P (pages 31-52). Moderate language but structural impact: contract renewal, variable economic terms, expiration of exploitation rights. Stable trend but critical weight for 40%+ of portfolio.

risks.title: Volatility of Oil and Natural Gas Prices
risks.score_rationale: Omnipresent risk in Item 5 (OFAR) and Item 11 (Market Risk). Intensive language on direct exposure to spot prices and contracts. Upward trend (energy transition, geopolitics). Dominant weight for E&P, Gas & LNG, Refining.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks and Sanctions in Key Zones
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in Item 4 (E&P in Africa, Middle East, Russia). Prudent language but tense geopolitical context (Ukraine, Iran, Libya). Upward trend. High weight for reserve portfolio.

risks.title: Energy Transition and Oil Asset Impairment
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk mentioned in Item 4 (decarbonization strategy) and Item 5. Moderate language but upward trend (EU regulation, declining demand). Increasing weight for E&P and Refining valuation.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Natural Gas and LNG
risks.score_rationale: Explicit in Item 4 (Global Gas & LNG Portfolio, p. 53). Moderate language on competition with US, Australian, and Qatari producers. Stable/upward trend. Medium weight for Gas & LNG segment (20%+ of revenues).

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks and Operational Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 16K (Cybersecurity disclosure). Prudent language but critical sector (energy infrastructure). Upward trend (increasing attacks). Moderate weight but potentially high impact.

risks.title: Environmental Regulation and Compliance Costs
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Item 4 (Environmental matters, p. 70) and Item 5. Intensive language on EU Taxonomy, CBAM, Scope 3 emissions. Upward trend (EU tightening). Increasing weight for all segments.

risks.title: Dependence on Exploration and Development Investments
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in Item 4 (E&P, pages 31-52) and Item 5 (Capex). Moderate language on exploration risks (dry wells, insufficient discoveries). Stable trend. High weight for reserve replacement.

ai_positioning.summary: Eni integrates technology and innovation to enhance its exploration and production energy operations while developing growth opportunities in low-carbon technologies such as CCS, biofuels, and renewable energy, generating material and diversified growth.
evidence: Organic E&P production growth of 9% YoY to 1.8 mln boe/d with exceptional exploration discoveries around 1 bln boe in Angola, Cote d'Ivoire, Libya, Egypt and Indonesia
Transition platform acceleration with major biorefining projects approved at Sannazzaro and Priolo hubs
Adjusted CFFO guidance raised 20% to EUR 13.8 bn, demonstrating strong underlying operational performance and improved scenarios
